title: Middle East export rebound (Saudi shipments up)
rationale: Middle Eastern oil exports rise; Saudi resumes Yanbu loading and boosts shipments (09-28/09-29).

title: Ongoing mediated US–Iran talks
rationale: US, Iran separately talk with mediators; reports talks set for Monday/Tuesday (09-28/09-29).

title: Talks on coordinated stock releases
rationale: IEA to discuss oil stock releases; White House urges EU to draw down diesel inventories (09-29).

title: Possible U.S. diesel export ban
rationale: Trump ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban; reports of political push and Goldman analysis (09-28).

title: EU consideration of demand-curbing measures
rationale: EU warns of energy price crisis and asks countries to consider curbing demand (09-27).

title: U.S. loan up to 40M barrels from SPR
rationale: US to loan up to 40 million barrels of oil from SPR, last batch from global deal (09-29).

title: Sanctions waiver for Iran‑Iraq flights
rationale: Exclusive: US to grant sanctions waiver for flights between Iran and Iraq's Najaf (09-28).

title: Implementation of eased U.S. fuel-economy rules
rationale: US finalizes new lower fuel economy standards; administration ends tougher rules (09-28/09-29).
